answer: A beacon flash opens each epoch: 36 slots only. Every identity answers inside one shared 15-minute window: grade three peer answers and sign them. One operator grades at most two sets per window, so ten fakes need five hands. The prism splits each set across three strangers; scores off by more than one on two answers burn 25 POA, failing renewal. Identical grade vectors count as one operator. Bonds rise 30 POA per extra identity from the same root, so ten fakes lock 2,350 POA and owe 30 graded answers each epoch. A missed window burns 25 POA per seat like an ember; two freeze the identity.
